hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *frontend/*.ts|*frontend/*.tsx|*frontend/*.js|*frontend/*.jsx|*frontend/*.json|*frontend/*.css|*frontend/*.scss|*frontend/*.html|*frontend/*.md) "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
